name: AudioBus
doc: One bus (category) in the mixer tree. AudioSource.bus names it.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Unique bus name; master configures the root bus.

fields.name: output
fields.doc: Bus this one mixes into; empty means master. (parent is reserved by the kernel.)

fields.name: mute
fields.doc: Silences the bus and its reverb sends.

fields.name: voiceLimit
fields.doc: Real-voice cap for this category and its children; 0 is unlimited.

fields.name: loudness
fields.doc: Integrated loudness target for sources on this bus (music and dialogue: -16 LUFS).

fields.name: reverb
fields.doc: Route spatial voices on this bus to the listener's room reverb.

fields.name: duck
fields.doc: Sidechain ducking driven by another bus.
